description: This Java source file defines an Android activity class IncomingMessage that provides UI for posting notifications, including methods to construct notification intents and show notifications with different styles.

classes.name: IncomingMessage
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates posting notifications with intents to launch specific activities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity UI and sets up button click listeners for posting notifications.

methods.name: makeMessageIntentStack
methods.description: Creates an array of intents representing the activity stack for a notification, enabling deep linking within the app.

methods.name: showAppNotification
methods.description: Builds and posts a notification simulating an incoming message with a pending intent that opens a detailed view.

methods.name: showInterstitialNotification
methods.description: Builds and posts a notification that launches an activity with flags set to start a new task, simulating an interstitial message.
